title: Sourcing End to End
description: Get sourcing working end to end. Reported blocker: `bun run dev:sourcing` exits with status 1 (nx run @semio-tech/framework-os-dev:dev -- sourcing). Diagnose and fix the launch path, then verify the sourcing app (curate document: Pool/Curated/Preview, beams/windows/slabs modules) actually boots and works interactively in the s product dev target (port 6081): artifact builds, editor/viewer render, commands, io and mutations round-trip through the pipeline.
summary:
Sourcing works end to end and was verified live.

1. **Build.** The sourcing hub, beams, slabs and windows components are built from clean, probe-free sources through `repo cargo --store=shared` (admitted, under the warden's unit ceilings), via `native-wasm-build.sh`.
   - The finished wasm files are exported to the ticket folder, because the cargo build folders get reclaimed.
   - Link-time optimisation is configured per build, and the sourcing builds run without it.
   - The hub app fleet is split into the `sourcing-editor` and `sourcing-viewer` crates, which keeps every final compile under its memory ceiling.
2. **Staging.** `native-stage-modules.ts` transpiles, assembles and checks each component and publishes the activation receipt. All four descriptors are `committed MATCH`.
3. **Live check.** The app boots on 127.0.0.1:6081. `sourcing-journey.ts` passes 17/17 in English and 17/17 in German:
   - boot without faults, all four windows render, the pool lists the ten demo stock kinds, the grid renders in 3D;
   - add, set count, undo/redo, preview, remove, drag in both directions;
   - filters by query, module, typology and minimum availability, sort;
   - the example switch;
   - folder save, reload and reconnect.
4. **Minimum availability.** The quick-blur stall (Defect 5) no longer reproduces, and the temporary probes are removed (`🎚️min-availability-fault.md`).
5. **Unrelated fix.** An orphaned `mod dbg` debug ledger was stripped from four framework sources (`strip-orphan-debug-ledger.py`). It pointed at a file deleted with its own ticket, so every cargo build in the repo failed.
6. **Memory.** The worker halt was fixed in ticket 26/11/24/WARDEN-COVERAGE-FOR-EVERY-REPO-TOOLCHAIN-PROCESS-AND-DISK-BOUNDED-SWAP.

Verification record: `✅️end-to-end-checklist.md` §7.

interactions.prompt: Get sourcing working end to end again (2026-11-23): plugin compiles, tests pass, sourcing app boots in s and the curation editor (Pool/Curated/Preview/Grid, beams/windows/slabs) works interactively — curation add/count/remove, drag, filters, sort, undo/redo, example switch, 3D grid and preview, archive save/reload. Fix any regressions introduced since September.
